physicalScale.render: frame bonePositions normalized by 1/S into native asset coordinates; bonePositionsMeters and bodyPositions/com remain SI
physicalScale.scope: 13 cm uniformly scaled koi proxy, source bluegill shape and initial SI velocity; authored active capacity and resistive water, no species or dynamic-similarity calibration

sourceClock.interpolation: quintic Hermite with shared central finite-difference first/second derivatives at each60Hz knot; C2, no stop-start rates
sourceClock.boundary: authored C2 multiplier on the five pre-turn/five post-turn observations only; marked turnframes preserved at all knots
sourceClock.retarget: P0→P2 defines posterior-directed anterior reference; flexible field P2→P6 mapped to koi bone5→33. This material/frame retarget is authored, not anatomical equivalence. No world orientation orCOM is prescribed. Coefficients use the production integrated quadratic curvature basis.
